name: Reckless Charge
body:
Benefit: A rogue with this talent can choose to gain an additional +2 bonus to attack and damage when making a charge attack. This bonus stacks with any other bonuses gained from charging into combat. When using this talent, the rogue loses any AC bonuses gained from Dexterity for the round.
